description:
Androgenic is the #1 AI-powered face analysis app for men who want to maximize their facial aesthetics. Get a detailed breakdown of your facial features, track your progress, and follow expert guides to transform your look.

FACE ANALYSIS & SCORING
• AI-powered analysis across 7 categories: masculinity, jawline, eyes, cheekbones, hair, skin, symmetry
• Overall score with percentile ranking (Top X%)
• Statistical report with bell curve, standard deviation, and confidence interval
• Celebrity look-alike matching
• 8 precise facial ratio measurements

DEMOGRAPHIC INSIGHTS (PRO)
• See how different demographic groups perceive your face
• Gender & age group perception breakdown
• Regional perception across 6 global regions
• Key insights into your strongest demographics

PHOTO RANKING (PRO)
• Upload 2-6 photos and find your best one
• AI scores lighting, angles, expression, and clarity
• "Best for" labels: Dating, Social Media, Professional
• Never post a bad photo again

MODEL CALIBRATION
• Pairwise face comparison system
• Help train the AI for more accurate results
• Gamified with accuracy scoring

23+ EXPERT LOOKSMAXXING GUIDES (PRO)

PROGRESS TRACKING
• Track your face score over time

• 30-day looksmaxxing challenges
• Streak system with XP and levels

COMMUNITY
